[[File:Tim Ellington DecipherCon 2002.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Tim Ellington at the Lord of the Rings Design-a-card Seminar, DecipherCon 2002]]
'''Tim Ellington''' was a Decipher game designer, mainly on the Star Trek CCG. He did additional design on the [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] (2001) and wrote the lore for its cards.<ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010820125115/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="jkpersonae">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/designdiary/personae.html Design Diary: Dramatis personae], decipher.com (2000–2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010224092942/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/designdiary/personae.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Star Trek CCG ==
At [[DecipherCon 2000]] Ellington opened the Star Trek CCG Design-a-Card seminar, run with [[Bill Martinson]] and [[Evan Lorentz]].<ref name="fkl1">[http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2000/reports/fkl1.html Design a Card, Any Card], Francis K. Lalumiere, Decipher, DecipherCon 2000 reports (2000). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010107220600/http://www.decipher.com:80/deciphercon/2000/reports/fkl1.html Internet Archive]</ref> At [[DecipherCon 2002]] he and Lorentz were billed for the Star Trek CCG Design-a-card Seminar.<ref name="stseminar">[http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2002/events/eventdescother.html DecipherCon 2002 event descriptions: non-tournament events], Decipher (2002). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030204113713/http://www.decipher.com:80/deciphercon/2002/events/eventdescother.html Internet Archive]</ref> The ''[[Star Trek CCG]]'' Second Edition rulebook (2002) credits "Second Edition Design: Evan Lorentz, Brad DeFruiter, Tim Ellington", with [[Brad DeFruiter]].<ref name="st2e">[http://decipher.com/startrek/rules/rulesST2E.pdf ''Star Trek'' CCG Second Edition rulebook], Decipher (2002), p. 30. Credits: "Second Edition Design: Evan Lorentz, Brad DeFruiter, Tim Ellington." Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030321233756/http://decipher.com:80/startrek/rules/rulesST2E.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
